result.summary: Backports pull request #36927 to the 30.x maintenance branch and updates release notes for v30.x. The changes remove CMake -Werror=dev flags from dev-mode build configurations and CI.
result.problem: Treating CMake developer warnings as errors (-Werror=dev) in developer mode and CI can lead to build failures as CMake versions and environments update on the maintenance branch.
evidence: Author description: 'Backports: * #36927', referencing merged build fix #36927 ('build: remove *dev* errors from dev-mode')
Milestone set to 30.6 for point release inclusion
result.scope_notes: Branch backport targeting the 30.x release branch.
result.card: Backports PR #36927 to the 30.x maintenance release branch and updates the 30.x release notes. It removes CMake -Werror=dev flags from dev-mode and CI configs to prevent CMake developer warnings from breaking builds. Importance is evidenced by backporting the fix already merged in #36927 into the 30.6 milestone.

risk.why: A flaw in build flags or CI configuration would only affect developer or CI builds on the 30.x maintenance branch.
